name: Rift Demon
body:
RIFT DEMON
CR 3

XP 800
CE Medium outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +4 natural)
hp 27 (5d10)
Fort +4, Ref +8, Will +1
Immune poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 claws +8 (1d6+3), bite +8 (1d6+3)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 17, Con 11, Int 12, Wis 10, Cha 15
Base Atk +5; CMB +8; CMD 21
Feats Flyby Attack, Hover, Wingover
Skills Acrobatics +11, Escape Artist +11, Fly +21, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (planes) +9, Perception +8, Stealth +11
Languages Abyssal, Common, Draconic, telepathy 100 ft.

ABOUT

Beautiful pink and yellow flowers dot this plant’s trunk, barely concealing the thorns jutting from all over its surface.
